content:
Ted Lasso’s long-awaited return is almost here, with season 4 premiering next week on Apple TV (watch here). And Apple has just unveiled the official trailer.

Ted Lasso season 4 trailer highlights beloved returning characters and new team

Next week brings Apple TV’s biggest premiere of the year: Ted Lasso season 4, which airs August 5.

The new season of the beloved Jason Sudeikis comedy arrives more than three years after the last season debuted. And it shifts focus from the AFC Richmond men’s team to a newly formed Lady Greyhounds team.

You can find a full rundown here of all the new cast members, plus who’s not coming back.

Today’s new trailer is light on plot details. Instead, it’s focused on stirring up the Lasso feels with Mumford & Sons music and glimpses of the characters we’ve been missing.

Here’s the official season 4 summary, followed by the new trailer:

If you’re a Ted Lasso fan, Trying is another excellent heartfelt comedy worth checking out on Apple TV. It’s currently airing its fifth season and has a 97% Rotten Tomatoes score.

What do you think of the new Ted Lasso trailer? Let us know in the comments.

Apple TV is available for $12.99 per month, or you can get it discounted through the Apple One bundle.
